title: review.commit record body
description: A reviewer seals a review before revealing it. The commitment binds the eventual review.formal, the per-paper review key and the reviewer's nullifier.

target.description: Record id of the paper.version under review.

commitment.description: Hash commitment to the sealed review content.

reviewKey.description: Public per-paper review key the revealed review is signed with.

nullifier.description: Uniqueness nullifier proving one review per reviewer per paper.
